title: Decision-theoretic gating: review-vs-error sweep
why: The frozen symmetric band leaves 75.5% of the 1,546 Egocentric-10K windows in REVIEW; the PoC needs <60%.
hypothesis: Deciding the most cost-confident windows and reviewing the rest cuts REVIEW below 60% at a measurable balanced-accuracy cost on gold LOCO, with asymmetric costs shifting the boundary.
data: gold LOCO-OOF caches/ensemble/oof_probs.npz (n=150, human); OOD-60 caches/ensemble/ood_scores.json (n=60, human, eval-only); 1,546 unlabelled /workspace/artifacts/windows_rescored.jsonl
method: Selective classification by cost-margin |p-p*|, p*=C_fa/(C_fa+C_fr); coverage 40-100%; costs 1:1/2:1/5:1; clip-bootstrap CI; LOCO temperature variant

title: Deterministic stage-0 triage + combined review pipeline
why: Decide additional REVIEW windows from cached quality signals (dark/over-exposed/frozen/undecodable) without re-decoding.
hypothesis: Deterministic quality rules decide a meaningful share of REVIEW windows with high precision on human-labelled subsets.
data: caches/gpu/features.json (150 gold + 60 synthetic degradations); 1,546 windows_rescored.jsonl features
method: Fixed a-priori descriptor-space quality rules; validated on synthetic degradations and 150 gold; applied to the 1,546 review windows; combined gating+stage-0+calibration pipeline review share

summary: Decision-theoretic gating: gating at coverage 45% (cost 1:1) cuts the 1,546-window REVIEW share 75.5%->55.0%; gold-LOCO BA 0.837 [0.645,0.937] (n=150); OOD-60 eval-only BA 0.496 (near chance, AUROC 0.415, n_bad=9); asymmetric costs 2:1/5:1 hurt (weighted err 0.309/0.382 vs 0.162).

Deterministic stage-0 rules fire on 6/6 of each synthetic black/darken/overexpose/frozen and 0/6 clean/blur/noise/shake/lowbitrate/static; on 150 gold they fire 3x (precision_bad 0.67, n=3, matching the funnel's no-certified-rule result); on the 1,546 they fire 39x (2.5%) and drop review 55.0%->54.0%. Combined pipeline reaches 54.0% review. Calibration (gold-LOCO temperature) is a no-op on share and hurts gold BA -> dropped.
decision: adopt stage-0 reject overlay; temperature off
